name: Janice Miner Holden
reason: Too thin and not a teaching practice: her own site (janholden.com) presents her as an academic near-death-experience researcher (UNT professor emerita of counselling, IANDS president, journal editor) with no courses, retreats or practices of her own; the only training mentioned is Induced After-Death Communication group training for grief counselling (therapy). Items would be two edited volumes (The Handbook of Near-Death Experiences; Connecting Soul, Spirit, Mind, and Body) and Wix-embedded videos whose YouTube IDs are not in the page, several of them grief-counselling themed. Contact form only. No Shift mention found. A human may still want her as an NDE authority (base not published beyond her UNT career in Denton, Texas).
